s: Starting next Monday, the third-floor printer will be replaced with a faster model.
The new printer can scan documents directly to your e-mail address.
To use this feature, simply enter your employee number on the touch screen.
A short guide will be posted next to the machine.
Please contact the IT desk if you have any problems.
items.why: "this feature" chỉ về chức năng quét tài liệu gửi thẳng vào e-mail ở câu trước.
w: The old printer will be moved to the basement next month.
Our IT staff work from 8 A.M. to 5 P.M. on weekdays.
Printing in color costs more than printing in black and white.
items.vi: Để dùng chức năng này, chỉ cần nhập mã nhân viên trên màn hình cảm ứng.

s: Thank you for booking a table at Olivetta for Saturday, June 3.
Unfortunately, our kitchen will be closed that evening for a private event.
As a result, we must cancel your reservation.
We would be happy to seat you on Friday or Sunday instead.
Please reply to this e-mail to choose a new date.
items.why: "As a result" nối với lý do ở câu trước: bếp đóng cửa tối hôm đó nên phải huỷ bàn.
w: Our new summer menu includes three seafood dishes.
Your table is next to the window, as you requested.
Parking is available behind the restaurant.
items.vi: Vì vậy, chúng tôi phải huỷ chỗ đặt của quý khách.

s: Brightway Gym is pleased to announce new evening hours.
Beginning May 1, the gym will stay open until 11 P.M. on weekdays.
These later hours are designed for members who work long shifts.
Weekend hours will not change.
For details, visit our front desk or check our Web site.
items.why: "These later hours" chỉ về giờ mở cửa tới 11 giờ đêm nêu ở câu trước.
w: The gym will be closed on May 1 for cleaning.
Members may bring one guest each month.
Our yoga instructor has twenty years of experience.
items.vi: Giờ mở cửa muộn hơn này dành cho hội viên làm ca dài.

s: Local bakery Crumb & Co. has opened a second shop on Harbor Street.
The owner, Rita Moss, started the business in her kitchen five years ago.
At that time, she sold bread only at the weekend farmers market.
Today, her shops employ fourteen people.
The new location will also offer coffee and sandwiches.
items.why: "At that time" chỉ về lúc bắt đầu kinh doanh trong bếp nhà, năm năm trước, ở câu trước.
w: The Harbor Street shop will open next year.
Most customers prefer coffee to tea.
Ms. Moss plans to close the first shop soon.
items.vi: Hồi đó, bà chỉ bán bánh mì ở chợ nông sản cuối tuần.
